content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Sumter

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific education and hours-of-experience thresholds to confirm you meet the baseline. Gather transcripts and project documentation now to streamline your application later.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions from anywhere—no travel required. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world scenarios and exam-aligned content over the required contact-hour span, preparing you thoroughly for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI, including your education, experience hours, and course completion proof. Pay the associated PMI exam fee. PMI will review and approve your eligibility before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A—to reinforce course material. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. You'll complete the exam and receive your score immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) across PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle by attending training, conferences, or performing volunteer work. Submit your renewal application and fee before expiration. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates your commitment to the profession.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
